content: Holi Spirit-mi agaa waru gupa lapa lagea: Orope yapi di epalia rabu aa medalomame kone rulae agaa gimalimi. Goa pua nimumi aa makirae wae remona agaa pagoa Satan-na kogono aanuna makirae agaa page pagalimi ta.
Go agaa madaare yaa agaa ne aanumiri nimumi makirae agaa teme rabu nimuna robaa-para i kone palakua yoa garuta-daa Satan-na kone sua teme.

Goa piane aa rurumiri nimu ona narumaape loa eta medaloma nanape lo mogeteme. Go teme pare abade Gote-me go etanu warisa-pulu niaa onaanumi ora agaa niminaawa kone rulaema-pulu go etanu madaa Gote-para ora pi loa mada nalima.
Oyae rayore Gote-me warisanare ora epe ta. Goa pea-ga wala meda pa nagimalimina yapare niaame mua Gote-para beten ora pi lamina.
Gore Gote-na agaa-para beten lapomere niaa Gote nipuna ruru onaa ma-aulaaya.
Timoti-ri Krais-na epe kogono aa pirina
Gore neme go agaa mana niaana amenu lakete-daare nere Yesu Krais-na kogono aa epe-rupa pirali. Goare nipuna agaa mada kone rulaawa go pageme agaa mogealiri ne puri pane kone mu pirali.
Goa pea pare onaa medalomame Gote-na agaa nalaawa pa remaa pamu teme-daare go makirae agaa nimimi masaa rilaatepape. Gote-na kone muare nimi puri mapalainalo pagalepape.

Gore niaana yogane puri mapalape kone gome niaa ogesi-daa raba mealia. Goa pea pare Gote-na kone gome niaa oro yaalo raba mealia. Goa pua abia niaa pa pima-rupa page orope epe-rupa piralimi rabu page go koneme niaa raba muali.
Go agaare ora agaa teme-ga onaa rayome pagoa kone rulalimina.

Go madaare Gote-me onaanu rayo ora yaalo makagaa piraama laama mapiraalia-pulu nipumi kone rulae onaanu-para goa palia. Goa pua niaame oro yaalo kagaa pirape Gote madaa kone rulaawa nipu ado pima. Goa pea-ga niaame Gote-na kone mulalo kalai pu kogono pamina.
Gore neme go agaare onaa rayo-para puri paloa agaa mana mogeape.

Gore ne pena ogege aa ae-ga nimumi nere pa aa meda kone nasalimi. Dia, pare neme agaa padane lo pora epe-rupa pamu pedo pu raaname omo kone rula epe-rupa piraina. Goa pali rabu onaanumi go epe kone rayo adoa ratulalo palimi.
Nina epalua-daare abi page gore Gote-na agaa mana ia-rupa onaanu pagena dipia lakelape. Goa pua neme nimu-para Gote-na pora waru kuraliminalo agaa lakelape.
Gore abade lotu-na aa mudunumi ne mada ki isimi rabu nimumi Holi Spirit-na puri meainalo Gote-na agaa lagisimi. Goa pisa-ga go agaana puri nagimape.
Gore onaa medalomame pora epe-rupa kura-mama palimi rabu adalimi. Goa pea-pulu oro yaalo go kogono pulalore nena kone rayome go kogono pua waru surubape.

Goa pua nena kone waru surubape. Go onaanu mogeali rabu waru piralimi. Oro yaalo neme go kogono puri paloa pape. Go kogono paama pali rabu nena agaa page ratalimide onaanu page ne page oro yaalo kagaa piraama laama palimi.
